evidence.symbol: SOQL multi-select picklist INCLUDES and EXCLUDES
evidence.notes: SOQL INCLUDES and EXCLUDES filter local multi-select picklist field values.

source.content: @isTest private class QueryRuntimeSOQLSOSLMultiSelectPicklistTest { @isTest static void filtersMultiSelectPicklists() { Product__c product = new Product__c(Name = 'Trail', PriceClasses__c = 'Member;Public'); insert product; List<Product__c> includesRows = [SELECT Id FROM Product__c WHERE PriceClasses__c INCLUDES('Member','Public')]; System.assertEquals(1, includesRows.size()); List<Product__c> excludesRows = [SELECT Id FROM Product__c WHERE PriceClasses__c EXCLUDES('Private')]; System.assertEquals(1, excludesRows.size()); } }
